Signals large-scale operational change that could lift productivity and margins.
Wide deployment increases likelihood of measurable efficiency gains.
AI already used in 10 countries representing half of revenues; scope is material.
Enterprise agreement enables rapid scaling without per-seat friction.
Rich data context could improve match rates and conversion.

This is a mid-cycle confirmation of Adecco’s push to embed agentic AI in core sales and recruitment workflows after earlier pilots. For this to be a larger catalyst, investors need quantified KPIs—time-to-fill, conversion, revenue per FTE, or margin uplift—from the rollout.
